events.content: I see my unopened tissue packet that I left to chope the seat has been moved and Rachel is sitting there. I intended packet to reserve the table while I buy food. Prefer (1) or (2). Speak clear, not loud, mention the packet and ask for seat back or sharing.

Eh Rachel, excuse me — I left this tissue packet to chope the seat before I went to buy my food. I come back and you move it and sit. This seat was for me. Can you please move leh? If not, we can share the table also. No need to make big thing.

Mr Lim says the tissue packet was to chope the seat. I did move the packet to the side before sitting because it looked unopened and the table looked empty — I didn't realise someone was actively reserving it. Goal: calm things down, get clarification, explain my side, and propose a fair solution (share or I move). Avoid getting embarrassed publicly; stay civil but assertive. If he actually left it to reserve, apologise for the misunderstanding and offer to move or share.

Waiting to see how Mr Lim responds so we can resolve this.
